text:
carmen: Heads-up, onboarding halcyon-int4-canary shows a new failure mode for funcalls when we return NDJSON/line-delimited JSON inside args.
devin: Example?
carmen: Router log: 
```
{"tool":"ingest_batch","args":"{\"records\":[\"{\\\"id\\\":1,\\\"text\\\":\"hello\"}\",\"{\\\"id\\\":2,\\\"text\\\":\"world\"}\"]}"}
```
carmen: Here the model wraps each NDJSON record in an escaped string ("\"{...}\"") and the outer args becomes a string. Validator expects an array/object.
tariq: Did this coincide with the int4 kernel landing?
carmen: Yes, the canary switch yesterday + NDJSON-heavy evals caused schema_pass to drop. Evals-bot: halcyon-int4-canary | funcall-schema-pass: 54% | fp16 baseline: 92% | N=600 | top: args_stringified(51%), nested_escape(29%).
evals-bot: note: most affected workloads are bulk-ingest and multilingual chat transcripts.
devin: Hypothesis: streaming cutpoints combined with quantized token sampler produce emitted literal quotes around each record, then the postprocessing joins into a single double-quoted JSON string.
tariq: Short-term: add a validator heuristic that if args is a string and matches NDJSON pattern (lines starting with { or [) attempt to splitlines then json.loads each line and reconstruct array. Tag telemetry "ndjson_unwrapped".
devin: Add guardrails: only unwrap if total lines < 1000 and total size < 512KB, and if >40% of lines parse successfully. Avoid silently transforming arbitrary strings.
carmen: Also saw retry duplication: our parse error triggers immediate client retry which re-invokes tool leading to duplicate ingests. We should: 1) make funcall ack before parser step or 2) make retry dedupe idempotent on an idempotency key.
tariq: For the canary do both: implement soft-unwrap + telemetry, and add idempotency header to router to dedupe within 10s window.
devin: Long-term: fix tokenization anchors for int4/quant kernels and add NDJSON-specific decoding in model postprocess so model emits actual arrays rather than stringified ndjson. File infra/runtime ticket.
carmen: I'll land the validator heuristic PR with toggles (off by default for stable). infra-bot: deploy requested: halcyon-int4-ndjson-unwrap-2026-03-23 by carmen -> rolling to 4% traffic.
evals-bot: re-eval scheduled in 20m. Suggest collecting per-config (streaming on/off) and record the ingestion-duplication rate.
devin: Capture raw token streams for 30 failed traces and attach to the ticket so tokenizers team can reproduce the split behavior.
tariq: I'll own the idempotency work. If after re-eval schema_pass < 80%, prepare rollback plan for int4 kernel.
carmen: Thanks all. Quick reminder: keep messages short in canary channels. :thumbsup:
